focus: Penske and Budget truck-rental desks with Houston addresses (North, Northwest, West, Southwest, and Southeast Houston, plus one Highway 6 South desk in the Sugar Land ZIP), and four labor-only crews with Houston offices
intro: This first Houston page covers official Penske and Budget truck-rental locations whose own location pages list a Houston address — including eleven Home Depot desks open seven days a week, most until 7:30 PM — plus four labor-only movers whose own sites publish a Houston address and hours. It is not a complete citywide inventory, and it does not report live truck counts; U-Haul, Enterprise, and most suburbs are not covered yet. One-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page mentions those services. If you already have a truck or container, use the labor-only filter or the HireAHelper box further down the page.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt with a phone line. Truck sizes on the lot are not listed as a fixed inventory here, and cargo vans are not mentioned.

offers: Truck, portable storage, and storage unit loading
listings.offersNotes: The official page offers hourly labor including loading and unloading of moving trucks, personal trucks, vans, portable storage, and storage units. It says next-day or same-day service is possible in many cases.
listings.visitNotes: Confirm crew availability for your date. Pricing is quoted by number of crew members and hours.
